description: Transient gateway failure + recent successful alternate payment method
expected_reasoning: Do not blindly retry identical route; prefer alternate recovery path where available.

description: Customer-side failure (insufficient funds) + payment method likely recoverable later
expected_reasoning: Bounded recovery action (payment link) rather than unnecessary escalation.

description: Systemic degradation signal + many simultaneous failures

expected_reasoning: Avoid repeating identical failed intervention; respect attempt history and stop.

description: Ambiguous provider error with high customer loyalty
expected_reasoning: Send a soft email or payment link rather than aggressive retry.

description: Conflicting historical signals (fraud history but low risk score)
expected_reasoning: Erring on the side of caution with manual review.

description: Provider API error indicating temporary maintenance
expected_reasoning: Hold action; do not send payment link while provider is down.

description: Missing or malformed contact info for customer
expected_reasoning: Cannot send payment link; escalate for manual review.
